scope: Fixture/application readiness only; not X2 learner, checker, owner, mounted or installed acceptance

custody.applicationAdministrator: Test-owned local fixture administrator; no production authority
candidateReceives: One authorized principal credential through a private binding
custody.boundary: Network/session-only candidate; separate custodian-owned directory mode 0700, files 0600
custody.unsatisfiedIf: Candidate can use arbitrary same-UID filesystem or process tools to read custody paths
custody.protectedPopulation: None; development application is not an unseen protected population
custody.publicEvidence: Retain actual response bytes with only test-issued identity/credential/CSRF/session redaction; retain unredacted originals privately

reporting.amount: Canonical unsigned decimal string, exactly two fractional digits, 1-18 integer digits, no redundant leading zero; never a Number
reporting.entity: Exact account-owned entity identity, independently issued
reporting.date: Real calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive 2026-01-01 through 2027-12-31
reporting.conversion: None. The tuple is preserved exactly; units and currencies are not interchangeable

domain.validation: Schema-valid drafts may contain 0.00 or an entity/currency mismatch. Validation records INVALID without creating a submission. VALID requires positive exact BigInt minor units and the entity's declared currency
unsupported: Durability certification against power loss/filesystem failure

independentBusinessRules: NEW has committed baseline reporting but no draft, validation, submission or approval.
A schema-valid authorized save persists exactly the reporting tuple and increments record/draft revisions; it invalidates earlier validation.
Authorized validation persists VALID or INVALID for the exact current draft and semantic revision. It does not submit or approve.
Semantic revision 1 submit requires a current VALID draft, exact target/principal/grant/application/schema/semantic/authority/record versions, request identity and unexpired deadline.
Submit first fsyncs an accepted pending request; its 202/toast is not a durable business submission.

A later independent completion transaction establishes SUBMITTED for that accepted request and the exact accepted tuple. Previously accepted effects survive later revocation, cancellation or caller death.
Approval requires a distinct approver principal, role and current approval grant, an exact durable submission identity, and current versions. Only approval updates committed reporting.
Semantic revision 2 keeps the Submit label and 202 but records validation confirmation only. It never creates a submission. Approval remains unavailable without a durable submission.
Rendering revision 2 changes markup, IDs, field names, ordering and HTML action paths, not the state machine. Read/API semantics remain independently compatible.
The preview mutation trap uses GET and the Preview label to invoke submission.create, never read authority. Wrong/read-only authority is denied at dispatch.

Normal reconciliation exposes authenticated record and exact request completion readback. Stable idempotency returns the original request and no new completion; new identities for an existing submission are rejected and journaled.

Opaque reconciliation masks version/phase/submission/approval/committed reporting equally before and after submission and makes every request lookup unavailable. It does not provide submission idempotency; repeated sends can produce independently journaled duplicate completions.
Every accepted mutation and denied dispatch records actual request identity and authorization snapshot independently of any candidate receipt.

The independent evaluator checks original objective/identities/terms, journal ordering, distinct approval authority, completion counts and dispatch attempts. It does not import provider transition code or candidate truth.
A candidate retry/new identity after ambiguous egress fails even if the normal provider prevents the duplicate business effect. Opaque missing-versus-accepted observation must remain UNKNOWN.

heldOutTemplate.record: Separately issued fresh record, not visible under discovery grants
heldOutTemplate.release: Administrator releases objective and fresh grants only after the main E2E freezes acquired-model bytes; fixture readiness does not claim that boundary

readinessCases.contract: Ready on ephemeral 127.0.0.1 port; no evaluator/admin HTTP routes
readinessCases.regression: Accidental all-interface bind or privileged inspection endpoint

readinessCases.contract: At least two independently issued records; held-out absent and cross-account read denied
Persist draft with exact strings; distinguish invalid validation, valid validation and unchanged committed baseline
readinessCases.regression: Number coercion, invalid terms accepted as valid, save treated as submission

readinessCases.boundary: Submission HTTP and separate authenticated readback
readinessCases.contract: 202 arrives while pending; later fsynced completion binds exact request/effect/terms; editor approval denied; distinct approver commits
Wrong actor, role, account, record, effect/request binding, units and stale versions deny without accepted effects
readinessCases.regression: Dispatch checks bypassed or stale facts reused

readinessCases.contract: Independent principal, role and grant revocation deny; prior accepted effects remain

readinessCases.boundary: Actual accessible HTML and API surface availability
readinessCases.contract: UI-only hides API/docs; hybrid exposes API preparation and HTML submission; login/logout and forms work without a learner driver
readinessCases.regression: Three profile names backed by one unrestricted API or inaccessible forms

readinessCases.boundary: Rendering/current semantic state and HTML dispatch
readinessCases.contract: Rendering revision changes structure/actions/names but preserves authorized transitions; same Submit label under semantic revision 2 has no submission
readinessCases.regression: Cosmetic revision changing business meaning or label assumed trustworthy

readinessCases.contract: Read-only grant denied; authorized explicit test send can submit via GET

readinessCases.boundary: Real response socket and durable journal
readinessCases.contract: Drop response after fsynced acceptance; lawful readback reconciles original identity; repeated normal request is idempotent; new identity rejected
readinessCases.regression: Simulated loss before wire or duplicate durable effect
readinessCases.missingStrongerCoverage: Physical SIGKILL of main native worker

readinessCases.contract: Absent and possibly accepted submission cannot be distinguished publicly; evaluator sees completion and can detect deliberate duplicate sends
readinessCases.regression: Hidden evaluator accidentally used as runtime observer

readinessCases.contract: Independent processes serialize store writes; single identity has one normal completion; provider restart reuses durable journal
readinessCases.regression: Lost update, duplicate async completion or in-memory persistence

readinessCases.contract: Held-out approved tuple passes independent grade; wrong objective and duplicate submission fail; raw failures preserved
readinessCases.regression: Fixture returns an authoritative candidate receipt or evaluator imports provider truth
